scope: Adoption decision over the unified-gate confirmation results (nfl_unified_confirm_689c93da35b5.json, committed in 112326e) for the arms that survived FRESH measurement. Served pool at decision time: the market-free 12 + is_home anchor (FEATURE_COLUMNS; admission gate retired 2026-09-02).
rule: tolerance_verdict six conditions (pooled AND sealed ll/auc/ece, each blocking; TOL ll 0.012 / auc 0.016 / ece 0.01) PLUS the adoption bar: deltas must be worth having, not merely 'not measurably worse'. Survivors whose margins sit within ~1/3 of tolerance are flagged as razor-thin noise and not adopted on that basis.

tier3_ROSTER.baseline: WITH_12 pool (served 12, current geometry, plain runner)
tier3_ROSTER.worth_having_check: FAIL - razor-thin noise. All six ll/auc legs are within ~1/3 of tolerance (sealed ll 0.8%, sealed auc 7%, pooled ll 34%, pooled auc 22% of TOL); the only substantive delta is the sealed-ECE improvement (-0.0349), a SINGLE-window (2025-only) leg that is contradicted by pooled ECE REGRESSION (+0.0055 = 55% of TOL, pooled ece 0.0396 vs 0.0341). Sealed ll/auc are exact ties (0.6234 vs 0.6233; 0.7084 vs 0.7095). Pattern matches the A5/AALL single-window-shimmer lesson: no pooled corroboration for the one big leg. Not worth having.
tier3_ROSTER.decision: KEEP OUT of the served pool

xgb_reg_C1_OPPADJ.candidate: served 12 + ewm_qb_epa_play_diff_oppadj + ewm_net_pts_diff_oppadj + ewm_ypp_diff_oppadj under REGULARIZED xgb
xgb_reg_C1_OPPADJ.baseline: C0_REG (served 12 under the SAME regularized xgb, current geometry)
xgb_reg_C1_OPPADJ.worth_having_check: FAIL - razor-thin AND parked on the tolerance edge. ll/auc legs are ties (all <= 23% of TOL; auc marginally better, ll marginally worse). BOTH ECE legs REGRESS to within ~0.002 of the tolerance ceiling: pooled ece +0.0088 = 88% of TOL (0.0409 vs 0.0321), sealed ece +0.0080 = 80% of TOL (0.0760 vs 0.0680). Second, the arm is inseparable from the REGULARIZED-xgb runner change: its measured gain exists only vs C0_REG, and C0_REG itself UNDERPERFORMS the production plain-runner 12 (pooled 0.6314/0.6925 vs C0 0.6201/0.7069; sealed 0.6350/0.6914 vs 0.6233/0.7095). Wiring C1 would wire a worse runner config plus three features that only marginally help that worse config. Not worth having.
xgb_reg_C1_OPPADJ.decision: KEEP OUT of the served pool

combined_arm_note: ROSTER and C1 are different families, so a combined arm would be required BEFORE any independent wiring. No combined arm was run: neither survivor cleared the worth-having bar, there is nothing to wire, and the default is no-change. The combined check becomes moot and can be run only if a future measurement clears an arm.

decision.verdict: NO-CHANGE - the market-free served 12-pool stands (12 features + is_home anchor).
decision.rejected_reason_summary: Both six-condition survivors fail the worth-having bar: ROSTER's only substantive leg is a single-window sealed-ECE improvement with no pooled corroboration (pooled ECE regresses); C1's ECE legs sit at 80-88% of tolerance and the arm requires switching to the regularized-xgb runner, which itself underperforms the production config on the identical 12-pool.
